name: Vincent Citro
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Orlando, Florida
about: Vincent Citro, an attorney with Losey PLLC in Orlando, Florida, helps clients address Criminal Defense situations. He also helps clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar concerns.
He received legal training from Stetson University College of Law. He graduated from law school in 2000. Vincent Citro became licensed to practice law in 2001.
Vincent Citro was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
